seoTitle: How to Find Your TradingView ID Easily
metaDescription: Learn where to find your TradingView user ID and username for scripts, alerts, broker connections, or support requests, and how to copy your profile link.
intro: Whether you need your TradingView ID for a support ticket, a broker connection, or sharing your profile, it's easy to confuse it with your username or profile link. This guide clears up the difference and shows exactly where to locate each one.

steps.heading: Understand what TradingView ID means
steps.body: Your TradingView ID typically refers to your account's unique identifier or username, used for things like support requests, script attribution, or broker linking.

steps.heading: Find your username and profile link
steps.body: Go to your TradingView profile page, where your username appears in the page URL and profile header.

steps.heading: Locate your ID on desktop and browser
steps.body: Check your account settings or profile page on the desktop site, since the ID or username is displayed consistently there.

steps.heading: Copy and share your profile link
steps.body: Copy the URL from your profile page to share it with others or paste it into a support request or broker connection form.

faq.question: Is my TradingView ID the same as my username?
faq.answer: For most purposes, your username functions as your identifiable ID on TradingView, visible in your profile URL.

faq.question: Why do I need my TradingView ID?
faq.answer: It's commonly needed for support requests, connecting broker integrations, or sharing scripts and profiles with other users.

faq.question: Can I change my TradingView username/ID?
faq.answer: TradingView allows username changes in account settings, though there may be limits on how often you can change it.

faq.question: Where do I find my ID on mobile?
faq.answer: Open your profile from the TradingView mobile app menu, where your username is displayed the same way as on desktop.
